from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    total_assets: float = Field(description="The reported Total Assets value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the assets, e.g., CNY/元")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the financial report period")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock exchange code if mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_asset_records: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
